subject: culinary-arts
intro: Culinary arts leads to the kitchens and dining rooms of the foodservice industry — line cooking and baking, the chef's command post, the manager's office, and the bars and floors that front the house.

roles.title: Chefs and Head Cooks
roles.what: Direct the kitchen: plan menus, price dishes, set standards for preparation and plating, train and supervise cooks, order ingredients, and keep every plate leaving the pass consistent through the busiest service.
roles.where: The mother sauces and stock work, flavour and menu planning, plating and presentation, and the costing unit are exactly the repertoire a head cook enforces on a brigade.

roles.title: Cooks, Restaurant
roles.what: Cook the menu on the line: prep stations before service, execute orders station by station to recipe and timing, plate to spec, and hold food safety and consistency through a full dinner rush.
roles.where: Unit 1's knife skills and mise en place, unit 2's dry-heat, moist-heat and fat-based methods, and the protein and vegetable cookery units are this role's daily work.

roles.title: Bakers
roles.what: Bake for retail and wholesale production: mix, proof and bake breads and pastries on schedules that start before dawn, weigh ingredients to formula, test doughs, and decorate and finish items for display cases.
roles.where: The baking-and-pastry unit — baker's percentages, yeast and fermentation, pastry doughs and desserts — is precisely the craft this occupation practises at volume.

roles.title: Food Service Managers
roles.what: Run the restaurant business: hire and schedule staff, control food and labour costs, manage supplier orders, enforce safety and sanitation compliance, and answer for service quality and profit.
roles.where: Unit 8's costing and food cost control, service styles and front-of-house topics, and unit 1's HACCP-based safety strand are the operating disciplines this role manages.

roles.title: Bartenders
roles.what: Run the bar: mix and pour drinks to recipe and local law, check identification, manage the till, keep the service area stocked and clean, and pace the room so every guest gets served.
roles.where: The seasoning-and-tasting palate, menu balance, and the service styles and front-of-house unit give the product knowledge and guest handling bar work is built on.
